# T-1: Restore upgrade evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add canonical upgrade evidence recovery before impl-gate so stale recovery can bypass, reuse, or regenerate evidence for the current source state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1 bypasses upgrade execution when no current upgrade-required paths exist.
- R2 and R3 reuse only current evidence or regenerate current evidence before impl-gate.
- R4 records durable audit evidence for each recovery decision.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the recovery owner in the lifecycle path before integration gate evaluation. Reuse existing changed-path detection and upgrade artifact writing. Bind current fingerprint and target authority separately from the original upgrade-result schema.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local Node tests for bypass, reuse/preserve, regeneration, audit content, and repeated stale recovery.
